messages.text: Rename this field to "Your first name" and make this input half as wide

agent.managerSummary:
The First-name input is now half-width on /contact. The label rename needs to be done in the Wix form builder — it's driven by the Wix form, not jay-html. Open the form [here](https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35) and change the First name label to "Your first name".
Dispatched to a new /contact lane — renaming the field to "Your first name" and shrinking the input to half width.

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
Validation passes with only pre-existing warnings (unrelated to this change).

**What I did**

- **Width (code):** Added a `first-name` class on the First-name `<input>` and a scoped CSS rule `.contact-form input.first-name { width: 50%; }` in `src/pages/contact/page.jay-html`. Last name, Email and Send stay full-width — layout intact.
- **Label (dashboard):** The "First name" label is a `{contact.firstNameD142.label}` binding driven by your Wix form, not jay-html. Per the wix-forms editing guide I didn't hard-code a new label. Rename it in the Wix form builder: https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35 — change the First-name field label to "Your first name" and it will appear on `/contact` automatically.
